DaysRipeBeforeFalling.Desc: A fruit is ripe the day it appears. It falls this many days later. 0 = the morning it appears. With Random Drops on, this is the minimum.
RandomDrops.Desc: Each fruit picks its own day to fall, between Days Ripe Before Falling and Max Days Ripe Before Falling.
MaxDaysRipeBeforeFalling.Desc: Only with Random Drops. The most days a ripe fruit stays on the tree before it falls.
DropAllInStorm.Desc: On a stormy (lightning) day every fruit tree drops all its fruit that morning.
FarmOnly.Desc: Only trees on the farm. Off = every location.
ShakePalmTrees.Desc: Shake down coconuts from palm trees every morning.
ShakeNormalTrees.Desc: Shake down seeds from other wild trees every morning.
